articles.author: Jeran Wittenstein, Ryan Vlastelica
articles.title: Big Tech Earnings Slam Into a Market in Revolt Over AI Spending - Bloomberg.com
articles.description: For years, US technology giants had a tacit agreement with investors: The companies could spend lavishly on artificial intelligence, and the stock market would reward them long as their revenues were rising. That deal is suddenly breaking down.
